plugins.name: mac-yolo-safeguards
plugins.description: macOS freeze guard, PreToolUse AI agent reliability firewall, 60s iOS Simulator reaper, and $10/mo token budget gate for Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, ChatGPT, Grok, and Perplexity.
plugins.longDescription: Mac YOLO Safeguards prevents runaway coding-agent sessions from freezing Apple Silicon Macs or burning through API token budgets. Includes 12 MCP tools with full Anthropic safety annotations (readOnlyHint / destructiveHint), a 60-second runaway iOS Simulator reaper, a 5-pillar macOS Smart Care scanner, process-storm protection that never kills active sessions, and cross-product integrations with ThumbGate (https://thumbgate.app) and Dayglass (https://dayglass.io).

plugins.name: thumbgate

plugins.installCommand: claude mcp add thumbgate -- npx -y thumbgate serve
